news_items.headline: MLBPA head criticizes MLB salary cap ad campaign as 'perverse'
news_items.description: MLBPA head Bruce Meyer chastised MLB management for its advertising campaign in support of a salary cap, saying their claims of economic woe are "perverse."

news_items.headline: Unique Ohtani rookie card sells privately for record $3.365M
news_items.description: A 1-of-1 rookie card of MLB star Shohei Ohtani has sold privately for a record $3.365 million.

news_items.headline: Jordan Walker hopes Home Run Derby win inspires Black kids
news_items.description: Cardinals outfielder Jordan Walker wants to be a role model, and he hopes his victory in the Home Run Derby inspires more Black kids to play baseball.

news_items.headline: The baseball world during Justin Verlander's MLB debut

news_items.headline: Tickets, rooms, mandates complicate MLB players in Olympics
news_items.description: Though support is growing for MLB to participate in the Olympics in 2028, it's complicated by disagreements with the MLBPA, according to sources.
